os_release:
PRETTY_NAME="postmarketOS v26.06"
NAME="postmarketOS"
VERSION_ID="v26.06"
VERSION="v26.06"
ID="postmarketos"
ID_LIKE="alpine"
HOME_URL="https://www.postmarketos.org/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://gitlab.postmarketos.org/postmarketOS"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://gitlab.postmarketos.org/postmarketOS/pmaports/issues"
LOGO="postmarketos-logo"
ANSI_COLOR="0;32"
extlinux_config:
timeout 1
default postmarketOS
menu title boot prev kernel

label postmarketOS
	kernel /vmlinuz
	fdtdir /
	initrd /initramfs
	append quiet splash plymouth.ignore-serial-consoles plymouth.prefer-fbcon earlycon console=ttyMSM0,115200 msm.allow_vram_carveout=1 cma=256m msm.vram=192m console=tty0 lk2nd.pass-simplefb=autorefresh lk2nd.pass-ramoops reboot=w pmos_boot_uuid=56e78f32-b1e4-4657-b17a-20b38489b8d6 pmos_root_uuid=3a052ba6-6796-43cf-bf72-49e246c9d8e3 pmos_rootfsopts=defaults
deployment_status: Full write/device and host readback verified; persistent Nura boot and SSH succeeded
